subject: maths
question: An architect designs a modern building facade using triangular glass panels. Each triangle has angles in the ratio 2:3:7. What is the measure of the largest angle in the panel?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 2 + 3 + 7 = 12 parts.

Total sum of angles in a triangle = 180º.

12 parts = 180º → 1 part = 15º.

Largest angle corresponds to 7 parts.

Measure = 7 × 15º = 105º.

**∴ The correct answer is 105º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **angles** in the **triangular glass panels** = 2 : 3 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Sum of all internal angles of a **triangle** = 180º

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ce11ca602b7b89286e38527d0f95d256900eb36a7e1e4d5c6f9335213127a5e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the angles be 2x, 3x, and 7x.

⇒ 2x + 3x + 7x = 180º

⇒ 12x = 180º

⇒ x = 180º ÷ 12

⇒ x = 15º

⇒ Largest angle = 7x = 7 × 15º

⇒ Largest angle = 105º

**∴ The correct answer is 105º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180º, regardless of its shape or size.

Obtuse-Angled Triangle

A triangle is classified as obtuse if one of its angles is greater than 90º. In this panel, 105º > 90º, so it is an obtuse triangle.

Ratio and Proportion in Geometry

To find individual components from a ratio a:b:c, multiply the total value by the fraction [part / (a+b+c)].</p
